sloka: शुशुभे राक्षस इन्द्रस्य स्वपतः शयन उत्तमम् ।गन्ध हस्तिनि सम्विष्टे यथा प्रस्रवणम् महत् ॥५-१०-१४॥
transliteration: śuśubhe rākṣasa indrasya svapataḥ śayana uttamam ।gandha hastini samviṣṭe yathā prasravaṇam mahat ॥5-10-14॥

translations.english: While the lord of demons lay asleep on the magnificent couch, he looked like the Prasravana hill with its elephant in rut.
